# Android TV app and a smoother QR pairing
### New
- **Frameside TV for Android TV, Google TV and Fire TV** (APK attached below, source in `android/`): opens the TV page full screen, **finds your server on the home network by itself**, keeps the screen on and works as a **screensaver** (Settings → Device preferences → Screen saver → Frameside). Pairing is the same as in the browser: the TV shows up in the app under *Devices → ＋ Add device*. Tested on an NVIDIA Shield (Android 11, 4K). Menu key or a long press on Back opens a small menu.
  Install: download the APK, put it on the TV (e.g. with the *Downloader* app, a USB stick or `adb install`), open **Frameside**.

### Fixed
- **QR code on the TV:** scanning it with the app now opens "Device found" with a name field right away (instead of the old pairing dialog without a name). An expired code shows a hint.
- The TV page fits the screen inside the Android TV app.

Update: `cd ~/immich-showcase && docker compose pull && docker compose up -d`. ☕ [ko-fi.com/frameside](https://ko-fi.com/frameside)
